observations.body: Prison, song, earthquake, and a household in Philippi. As we were going to prayer, a certain girl having a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much gain by fortune telling. They went out of the prison and entered into Lydia’s house. When they had seen the brothers, they encouraged them, then departed.

payload.posture: Read Acts 16:16–40 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states prison, song, earthquake, and a household in Philippi. As we were going to prayer, a certain girl having a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much gain by fortune telling. They went out of the prison and entered into Lydia’s house. When they had seen the brothers, they encouraged them, then departed. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
